feedback.returningDescription: You've been back a few times — we'd love a quick star rating and any thoughts. It really helps.

homeScreen.title: One last step — make it 1 tap away
homeScreen.body: Save MyPhonicsBooks to your home screen. Tomorrow, hand the phone to your child — they tap the icon and start reading. No logging in. No typing.
homeScreen.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
homeScreen.iosStep2: Scroll down → tap "Add to Home Screen"
homeScreen.otherDevice: Open this page in Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone) on your phone to install the app to your home screen.
